title: ranunculus aquatilis var. calvescens
intro: Ranunculus aquatilis var. calvescens, commonly known as White Water Buttercup, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating wounds and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus aquatilis var. calvescens include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
